name: Stark County, OH
findings: Stark County has 1,373 nonprofit organizations. 530 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 399 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Stark County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few education organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 6 education organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 14 would.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 93 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
